answer: Sybil resistance works like a jetty with 7 fixed berths, filled each epoch by sealed-bid burn auctions: every bid burns, clearing price is the lowest losing bid, losers burn 10% more. At a 500-unit floor, an attacker grabbing 4 of 7 berths burns 500+1000+1500+2000=5000 units per epoch while an honest agent pays 500 once, so fake identities multiply burn faster than votes. Nothing is refundable, so no relic of reputation is reusable; each identity re-pays full burn per epoch. Each validating berth lights a lantern for peers who audit which paid berth issued each attestation.
